reason: The clean-room subprocess again wrote the same complete fsynced raw bundle but did not return to its parent.
root_cause: The child inherited an output pipe whose reader had been detached by the host launcher. Its final nonessential JSON status print could therefore block after the evidence result was complete.
corrective_action: Successful clean-room children now exit immediately after the fsynced result return path, without writing a final status message to stdout. A new framework freeze and full reproduction are required.
